VERIFIED.label: Verified: the citation resolves to an indexed case and the quote appears in the indexed text of the case, word for word apart from line breaks, quote marks, dashes and spacing.

EXISTS_QUOTE_NOT_FOUND.label: quote not found in the indexed text of the case

CONFLICT.label: conflict: the citation matches more than one indexed case

MALFORMED.label: Exactly one parseable citation is required.

IN_INDEX.label: Found in the index (existence only): no quote was checked, so this is not a verification.
